dadar.localIntro: Dadar is the heart of central Mumbai, split by the railway line into Dadar West under pincode 400028 and Dadar East under 400014. It is one of the city's oldest planned residential neighbourhoods, and the housing is a genuine mix: older co-operative buildings and chawls around Shivaji Park and Hindu Colony, redeveloped mid-rise towers along the main roads, and a growing number of newer high-rises near Dadar Railway Station. Households are largely long-settled Maharashtrian and Gujarati families, many of them multi-generational with elderly members at home, alongside working professionals who value the location between South Mumbai and the suburbs. Shivaji Park, Chaityabhoomi on the seafront and the Siddhivinayak Temple just across the Prabhadevi boundary give the area its character, while the Dadar Flower Market sets the early-morning rhythm on the station side. Mahim and Matunga adjoin Dadar to the north, with Prabhadevi and Parel to the south. Regular cooking help, daily cleaning and elder-care support are the typical requirements here, with families usually preferring helpers who can commit to fixed long-term timings.
dadar.commuteNotes: Dadar is the interchange between the Western and Central suburban railway lines, so helpers arrive easily from across the city, and BEST buses connect it to every neighbouring area. Many helpers also walk or take a short bus ride in from Dharavi and the Prabhadevi and Parel side.
dadar.housingNotes: Housing ranges from older co-operative societies and chawls to redeveloped towers, so entry rules vary building by building. Newer societies keep watchmen registers and helper ID entries, while older buildings tend to be informal and flexible on timings.

localFaqs.q: Which areas near Dadar do you also serve?
localFaqs.a: Mahim, Matunga, Prabhadevi, Parel and Wadala are all covered by the same nearby helper pool as Dadar. Both Dadar West and Dadar East fall under this locality's coverage.

localFaqs.q: Which pincodes does Dadar service cover?
localFaqs.a: Dadar coverage spans pincode 400028 for Dadar West and 400014 for Dadar East. Adjacent areas such as Mahim (400016) and Matunga (400019) have their own pincodes but share the same helper network.

localFaqs.q: Do helpers in Dadar need society gate passes?
localFaqs.a: It depends on the building. Redeveloped towers and larger societies near Shivaji Park usually ask for a helper ID entry at the gate, while older co-operative buildings and chawls rarely have a formal pass system.

mahim.localIntro: Mahim, under pincode 400016, sits at the northern tip of the island city where the Mahim Causeway carries traffic across the creek to Bandra. It is an old and closely built neighbourhood with a mixed housing stock: heritage-era buildings and Catholic villas in the lanes near St. Michael's Church, co-operative societies along Lady Jamshedji Road, and redeveloped towers coming up around Mahim Railway Station. Households here are mostly long-settled families, many with senior members, together with medical professionals connected to P.D. Hinduja Hospital and working couples who choose Mahim for its position between Dadar and Bandra West. The Mahim Dargah on the seafront draws visitors through the week, and the Mahim fair each December fills the area around it. Dadar is immediately to the south, Bandra West lies just across the causeway and Matunga is a short distance east. Daily cleaning, cooking and elder care are the most common requirements, and families here typically look for helpers who can stay with a household over the long term.
mahim.commuteNotes: Mahim Railway Station on the Western line and BEST bus routes along Lady Jamshedji Road and Cadell Road serve the area well. A large share of helpers walk in from Dharavi, which borders Mahim on the eastern side.
mahim.housingNotes: The stock mixes older low-rise buildings and villas with newer redeveloped towers, so gate rules differ from one society to the next. Older buildings are informal about entry, while the newer towers keep a watchman register for domestic staff.

localFaqs.q: Which areas near Mahim do you also serve?
localFaqs.a: Dadar, Matunga and Prabhadevi on the island-city side and Bandra West across the causeway are all served by the same nearby helper pool. Helpers who work in Mahim frequently take assignments in these adjoining areas too.

localFaqs.q: Which pincode does the Mahim service area cover?
localFaqs.a: Mahim falls under pincode 400016. Neighbouring Dadar carries 400028 and 400014, and Bandra West carries 400050, but the same helper network covers all of them.

localFaqs.q: Do helpers in Mahim need society gate passes?
localFaqs.a: Older buildings in the lanes near St. Michael's Church and the Mahim Dargah rarely have a formal pass system. Newer redeveloped towers near Mahim Railway Station usually ask for the helper's details to be noted at the gate.

matunga.localIntro: Matunga, under pincode 400019, is one of central Mumbai's most settled residential neighbourhoods, laid out in the early twentieth century with wide roads, gardens and a strong South Indian community. The housing is mixed: well-kept older co-operative buildings and art-deco blocks around King's Circle and Five Gardens, a few chawls and low-rise homes, and redeveloped towers appearing on the main roads. Households are predominantly long-settled families, often with elderly parents at home, and there is a sizeable student population drawn by Ruia College, Podar College and VJTI, which gives the area a steady demand for paying-guest and shared-flat arrangements. Matunga Railway Station on the Central line and Matunga Road on the Western line keep the area well connected, and the tree-lined Five Gardens remains the neighbourhood's main open space. Dadar lies immediately to the west, Sion to the north and Wadala to the east. Cooking help familiar with vegetarian and South Indian kitchens, daily cleaning and elder care are the typical requirements here, with most families preferring helpers on fixed long-term arrangements.
matunga.commuteNotes: Matunga is served by Matunga Railway Station on the Central line and Matunga Road on the Western line, with BEST buses running along Bhaudaji Road and Sion Road. Many helpers walk in from Dharavi, which lies just across the Sion side.
matunga.housingNotes: Most homes are in older co-operative societies where the building watchman handles entry and timings stay flexible. The newer redeveloped towers on the main roads tend to keep a register of domestic helpers at the gate.

localFaqs.q: Which areas near Matunga do you also serve?
localFaqs.a: Dadar, Sion, Wadala and Mahim are all covered by the same nearby helper pool as Matunga. Helpers working around King's Circle and Five Gardens often take assignments in these adjoining areas as well.

localFaqs.q: Can I find a cook in Matunga who handles South Indian vegetarian food?
localFaqs.a: Matunga has a large vegetarian and South Indian community, so cooks familiar with these kitchens are a common requirement in the 400019 area. You can state your cuisine and dietary preferences when you post the requirement so that only suitable profiles are matched.

localFaqs.q: Do helpers in Matunga need society gate passes?
localFaqs.a: Older co-operative buildings around Five Gardens and King's Circle generally rely on the watchman and do not issue formal passes. Newer towers near Matunga Railway Station may ask for a helper ID entry, so it is worth checking with your society office.

sion.localIntro: Sion, under pincode 400022, marks the historic boundary of Mumbai's island city, and the small hilltop Sion Fort still overlooks the junction where the Eastern Express Highway begins. The neighbourhood has a mixed housing stock: older co-operative societies and colonies such as Sion Koliwada and Pratiksha Nagar, chawls near the station, and newer redeveloped towers along the highway and Sion Circle. Households are mainly long-settled families, many with elderly members, plus working professionals who use Sion as a base between South Mumbai, Bandra-Kurla Complex and the eastern suburbs. Sion Hospital, one of the city's largest public hospitals, brings a large medical and nursing community to the area, while Gandhi Market is the local shopping hub and the Maharashtra Nature Park offers rare green space on the Mithi River side. Matunga adjoins Sion to the south, Kurla lies just north across the highway and Wadala is to the east. Daily cleaning, cooking help and elder care are the usual requirements, with hospital-linked households often needing helpers on early or shift-based timings.
sion.commuteNotes: Sion Railway Station on the Central line and BEST buses along the Eastern Express Highway and Sion-Bandra Link Road make the area easy to reach. Dharavi lies immediately to the west, and many helpers walk in from there.
sion.housingNotes: Older societies and chawls are informal about entry, while the newer redeveloped towers along the highway keep helper registers at the gate. Timings are generally flexible except in the larger gated complexes.

localFaqs.q: Which areas near Sion do you also serve?
localFaqs.a: Matunga, Kurla, Wadala, Antop Hill and Chembur are all covered by the same nearby helper pool as Sion. Helpers based around the Dharavi side regularly take assignments across these adjoining areas.

localFaqs.q: Which pincode does the Sion service area cover?
localFaqs.a: Sion falls under pincode 400022, which includes the areas around Sion Hospital, Sion Circle and Sion Koliwada. Neighbouring Matunga carries 400019 and Kurla 400070.

localFaqs.q: Can I get a helper in Sion on shift-based or early-morning timings?
localFaqs.a: Because Sion Hospital and nearby offices bring many shift workers to the area, requests for early-morning or split-shift help are common here. Mention the exact timings in your requirement so that only helpers available in those slots are matched.

kurla.localIntro: Kurla, under pincode 400070, is a busy transport and commercial hub where the Central and Harbour railway lines meet, with Lokmanya Tilak Terminus handling long-distance trains on the eastern side. Its housing is a genuine mix: dense older chawls and low-rise buildings near Kurla Railway Station and along LBS Marg, mid-rise co-operative societies in Nehru Nagar and Kurla East, and newer gated complexes such as Kohinoor City and the towers around Phoenix Marketcity in Kurla West. The Bandra Kurla Complex business district lies just across the Mithi River, so a large share of newer residents are working professionals and young families renting close to their offices. Sion adjoins Kurla to the south, Ghatkopar and Chembur lie to the east and Bandra East is across the river to the west. Daily cleaning and cooking help for working couples are the most common requirements, along with full-time help for families in the larger societies, and the area's dense population means a good supply of helpers living within walking distance.
kurla.commuteNotes: Kurla Railway Station serves both the Central and Harbour lines, and BEST buses run along LBS Marg and towards Bandra Kurla Complex. Most helpers live within Kurla itself or in adjoining parts of Sion and Ghatkopar and reach households on foot or by share auto.
kurla.housingNotes: Newer gated complexes such as Kohinoor City keep helper ID registers and fixed entry rules, while the older chawls and co-operative buildings around the station are informal and flexible on timings.

localFaqs.q: Which areas near Kurla do you also serve?
localFaqs.a: Sion, Chembur, Ghatkopar and Bandra East are all covered by the same nearby helper pool as Kurla. Households in Bandra Kurla Complex are typically served by helpers based on the Kurla side of the river.

localFaqs.q: Which pincode does the Kurla service area cover?
localFaqs.a: Kurla falls under pincode 400070, which covers the areas around Kurla Railway Station, Lokmanya Tilak Terminus and Kohinoor City. Neighbouring Sion is 400022 and Ghatkopar is 400086.

localFaqs.q: Do helpers in Kurla need society gate passes?
localFaqs.a: The larger gated complexes near Phoenix Marketcity and in Kohinoor City generally require a helper ID entry at the gate. Older buildings and chawls near the station usually have no formal pass system and rely on the watchman.

powai.localIntro: Powai, under pincode 400076, is a planned lakeside suburb in the eastern part of Mumbai built around Powai Lake and the IIT Bombay campus. Housing here is dominated by gated societies: the neo-classical towers of Hiranandani Gardens set the pattern, and newer high-rise complexes along Chandivali Farm Road and towards the lake follow the same model, with security desks, visitor registers and shared amenities. Households are largely working professionals employed in the corporate offices and IT parks around Hiranandani and Chandivali, along with young families and a steady population of expatriates and faculty linked to IIT Bombay. Galleria Powai is the everyday shopping and dining hub, and Dr L H Hiranandani Hospital serves the neighbourhood. Vikhroli lies to the east across the Eastern Express Highway side, Andheri East is reached along Jogeshwari-Vikhroli Link Road, and Ghatkopar is to the south. Full-time and part-time cooking, daily cleaning and nanny support for dual-income households are the main requirements, and most societies expect helpers to carry a registered ID for gate entry.
powai.commuteNotes: Powai has no suburban railway station of its own, so helpers usually take BEST buses or share autos along Jogeshwari-Vikhroli Link Road from Vikhroli, Kanjurmarg or Andheri East. Many helpers live in Chandivali and Saki Naka and reach Hiranandani on foot or by a short auto ride.
powai.housingNotes: Almost all homes are in gated towers with security desks, so helpers need to be registered with the society and often carry a society-issued ID card. Entry timings are fixed by each society, which suits regular daily arrangements.

localFaqs.q: Do helpers in Powai need society gate passes?
localFaqs.a: Yes, in most cases. Gated complexes in Hiranandani Gardens and along Chandivali Farm Road require domestic helpers to be registered with the society office and usually issue an ID card for gate entry. Please complete this registration once you finalise a helper.

localFaqs.q: Which areas near Powai do you also serve?
localFaqs.a: Vikhroli, Andheri East, Ghatkopar and Bhandup are all covered by the same nearby helper pool as Powai. Helpers based in Chandivali and Saki Naka regularly take assignments across these areas.

localFaqs.q: Which pincode does the Powai service area cover?
localFaqs.a: Powai falls under pincode 400076, which covers Hiranandani Gardens, the IIT Bombay side and the Chandivali stretch. Neighbouring Vikhroli is 400078 and Andheri East is 400059 and 400093.

ghatkopar.localIntro: Ghatkopar, under pincode 400086, is one of the largest residential suburbs on Mumbai's Central line, spread across Ghatkopar West and Ghatkopar East on either side of the railway. Its housing is mixed: long-established co-operative societies in Pant Nagar, Garodia Nagar and Tilak Road, redeveloped mid-rise towers, and a number of newer gated complexes along LBS Marg near R City Mall. Households are predominantly Gujarati and Maharashtrian families, many of them multi-generational with elderly members, together with working professionals who value the Metro Line 1 link from Ghatkopar Metro Station to Andheri and the airport belt. Ghatkopar Railway Station is a major Central line stop, R City Mall is the main shopping and cinema destination, and the Somaiya Vidyavihar campus borders the area to the south. Vikhroli lies to the north, Kurla and Chembur to the south-west and south, and Powai is a short drive up the hill road. Cooking help for vegetarian households, daily cleaning and elder care are the usual requirements, with most families preferring fixed long-term arrangements.
ghatkopar.commuteNotes: Ghatkopar Railway Station on the Central line and Ghatkopar Metro Station, the eastern terminus of Metro Line 1, make the area one of the easiest suburbs to reach. BEST buses and share autos run along LBS Marg and into the inner colonies of Ghatkopar East.
ghatkopar.housingNotes: Older co-operative societies rely on the watchman and keep flexible timings, while the newer gated complexes along LBS Marg ask for helper ID registration at the gate. Redeveloped buildings increasingly follow the gated model.

localFaqs.q: Which areas near Ghatkopar do you also serve?
localFaqs.a: Vikhroli, Kurla, Chembur and Powai are all covered by the same nearby helper pool as Ghatkopar. Both Ghatkopar West and Ghatkopar East fall under this locality's coverage.

localFaqs.q: Which pincode does the Ghatkopar service area cover?
localFaqs.a: Ghatkopar falls under pincode 400086, covering both sides of Ghatkopar Railway Station including Pant Nagar and the R City Mall stretch. Neighbouring Vikhroli is 400078 and Kurla is 400070.

localFaqs.q: Can I find a cook in Ghatkopar for a vegetarian household?
localFaqs.a: Ghatkopar has a large vegetarian population, so cooks experienced with vegetarian Gujarati and Maharashtrian kitchens are a common requirement here. Mention your dietary preferences when posting so that only suitable profiles are matched.

chembur.localIntro: Chembur, under pincode 400088, is an established suburb on Mumbai's Harbour line, known for its green pockets, gymkhanas and a long-settled community. The housing stock is mixed: older co-operative societies and bungalow plots around Diamond Garden and Chembur Camp, refinery and government colonies dating from the area's industrial past, and a wave of newer redeveloped towers along the Eastern Freeway approach and Sion-Trombay Road. Households are largely families, many with elderly members who have lived here for decades, joined in recent years by working professionals who use the Eastern Freeway and the monorail to reach South Mumbai and Wadala. Chembur Railway Station and Chembur Monorail Station sit close together in the central market area, K Star Mall is the main shopping stop and the Tata Institute of Social Sciences campus lies on the Deonar side. Ghatkopar adjoins Chembur to the north, Kurla lies to the north-west and Sion is to the west. Daily cleaning, cooking help and elder care are the most common requirements here, with a steady supply of helpers from the adjoining Govandi and Mankhurd side.
chembur.commuteNotes: Chembur Railway Station on the Harbour line and Chembur Monorail Station serve the area, and BEST buses run along Sion-Trombay Road and the Eastern Express Highway. A large share of helpers live in Govandi and Mankhurd and reach Chembur by bus, share auto or on foot.
chembur.housingNotes: Older societies and colony housing around Diamond Garden are informal about entry, while the newer redeveloped towers keep helper registers and fixed entry timings at the gate.

localFaqs.q: Which areas near Chembur do you also serve?
localFaqs.a: Ghatkopar, Kurla, Sion and Wadala are all covered by the same nearby helper pool as Chembur. Helpers based in Govandi and Mankhurd regularly take assignments across these areas.

localFaqs.q: Which pincode does the Chembur service area cover?
localFaqs.a: This locality is listed under pincode 400088, which covers the Chembur East and Deonar side near the Tata Institute of Social Sciences. Households in the Diamond Garden and Chembur Camp stretch can post their exact address and the nearest helper pool will be matched.

localFaqs.q: Is elder care available in Chembur?
localFaqs.a: Yes. Chembur has a large population of long-settled senior residents, so attendants and helpers experienced in elder care are a common requirement here. Specify whether you need day-time support or a live-in arrangement when posting your requirement.

vikhroli.localIntro: Vikhroli, under pincode 400078, is a Central line suburb shaped by the Godrej group's Pirojshanagar township, which occupies a large stretch between the railway and the Eastern Express Highway. The housing stock is mixed: long-established Godrej staff colonies and older co-operative buildings on the west side, the dense MHADA colonies of Kannamwar Nagar and Tagore Nagar in Vikhroli East, and newer gated towers coming up along LBS Marg and near the Godrej One office campus. Households are mainly working families, many employed in the Godrej offices and factories or in the corporate parks of nearby Powai, together with young professionals renting close to the Jogeshwari-Vikhroli Link Road. The Vikhroli Mangroves along the creek are one of the largest protected green belts within the city, and Vikhroli Railway Station keeps the area on the main commuter route. Ghatkopar adjoins Vikhroli to the south, Bhandup lies to the north and Powai is just up the link road to the west. Daily cleaning and cooking help for working households are the usual requirements, with a good supply of helpers living within Vikhroli East itself.
vikhroli.commuteNotes: Vikhroli Railway Station on the Central line and BEST buses along LBS Marg and Jogeshwari-Vikhroli Link Road serve the area. Most helpers live within Vikhroli East colonies such as Kannamwar Nagar and walk or take a share auto to households on either side of the railway.
vikhroli.housingNotes: The MHADA colonies and older buildings are informal about entry and flexible on timings, while the newer gated towers along LBS Marg keep helper registers and fixed entry hours.

localFaqs.q: Which areas near Vikhroli do you also serve?
localFaqs.a: Ghatkopar, Powai, Bhandup and Kurla are all covered by the same nearby helper pool as Vikhroli. Both Vikhroli West and Vikhroli East fall under this locality's coverage.

localFaqs.q: Which pincode does the Vikhroli service area cover?
localFaqs.a: Vikhroli is listed under pincode 400078, which covers the Kannamwar Nagar and Tagore Nagar side of Vikhroli East. Households on the Vikhroli West side near Godrej Pirojshanagar can post their exact address and will be matched with the same helper pool.

localFaqs.q: Do helpers in Vikhroli need society gate passes?
localFaqs.a: Newer gated towers near the Eastern Express Highway and LBS Marg usually ask for a helper ID entry at the gate. Older colony buildings and the MHADA societies of Vikhroli East generally have no formal pass system.

bhandup.localIntro: Bhandup, under pincode 400083, is a Central line suburb between Vikhroli and Mulund that has changed from an industrial belt into a largely residential area over the past two decades. The housing is mixed: older chawls and co-operative buildings near Bhandup Railway Station and along LBS Marg, dense hillside settlements on the western edge, and a growing number of gated towers built on former factory land, especially around Dreams Mall and Neptune Magnet Mall. Households are mostly middle-class Maharashtrian families, many of them first-generation buyers in the newer complexes, together with working professionals who commute to Powai, Vikhroli and the Thane side. The Eastern Express Highway runs along the eastern boundary and links the area to Mulund and Sion, while LBS Marg is the main local artery for shops, buses and share autos. Vikhroli adjoins Bhandup to the south and Mulund to the north, with Powai reachable across the hill road to the west. Daily cleaning and cooking help for working households and full-time help for families in the larger societies are the typical requirements.
bhandup.commuteNotes: Bhandup Railway Station on the Central line and BEST buses along LBS Marg and the Eastern Express Highway serve the area. Most helpers live within Bhandup West's older colonies and hillside settlements and reach households on foot or by share auto.
bhandup.housingNotes: Newer gated complexes built on former industrial plots keep helper registers and fixed entry timings, while the older chawls and co-operative buildings near the station are informal and flexible.

localFaqs.q: Which areas near Bhandup do you also serve?
localFaqs.a: Vikhroli, Mulund, Mulund East and Powai are all covered by the same nearby helper pool as Bhandup. Helpers working along LBS Marg frequently take assignments in these adjoining areas.

localFaqs.q: Which pincode does the Bhandup service area cover?
localFaqs.a: Bhandup is listed under pincode 400083, which covers the Bhandup West side around Bhandup Railway Station and LBS Marg. Households in Bhandup East can post their exact address and will be matched with the same helper pool.

localFaqs.q: Do helpers in Bhandup need society gate passes?
localFaqs.a: The newer gated towers near Dreams Mall and Neptune Magnet Mall usually require a helper ID entry at the gate. Older buildings and chawls near the station generally have no formal pass system and rely on the watchman.

mulund.localIntro: Mulund, under pincode 400080, is the northernmost suburb on Mumbai's Central line before Thane, and the Mulund West side covered here is one of the more spacious and green residential belts in the eastern suburbs. Housing is dominated by gated societies: large co-operative complexes and newer high-rise townships on former industrial land along LBS Marg and Goregaon-Mulund Link Road, with a few older buildings near Mulund Railway Station and the market lanes. Households are largely Gujarati and Maharashtrian families, many multi-generational with elderly members, along with working professionals who commute to Powai, Vikhroli and the Thane business belt. R Mall Mulund and the shopping stretch around the station serve everyday needs, Fortis Hospital Mulund is the main private hospital, and the Yogi Hills and the Johnson and Johnson Garden provide green space at the foot of the Sanjay Gandhi National Park boundary. Mulund East lies just across the railway line, Bhandup adjoins to the south and Vikhroli is further down the line. Cooking help for vegetarian households, daily cleaning and elder care are the typical requirements, with most societies expecting helpers to be registered at the gate.
mulund.commuteNotes: Mulund Railway Station on the Central line and BEST buses along LBS Marg serve the area, with share autos covering the inner lanes. Helpers commonly come from the older colonies on the Bhandup side and from Mulund East.
mulund.housingNotes: Most homes are in gated societies and townships with security desks, so helpers are usually registered with the society office and enter on fixed timings. Older buildings near the station remain informal.

localFaqs.q: Do helpers in Mulund need society gate passes?
localFaqs.a: Yes, in most large complexes along LBS Marg and Goregaon-Mulund Link Road, where the society office registers domestic helpers and issues an entry ID. Older buildings near Mulund Railway Station generally rely on the watchman instead.

localFaqs.q: Which areas near Mulund do you also serve?
localFaqs.a: Mulund East, Bhandup and Vikhroli are all covered by the same nearby helper pool as Mulund West. Households in Powai are also within reach for helpers based in this belt.

localFaqs.q: Which pincode does the Mulund service area cover?
localFaqs.a: This locality covers Mulund West under pincode 400080. Mulund East, across the railway line, is listed separately under 400081 but is served by the same helper network.

mulund-east.localIntro: Mulund East, under pincode 400081, lies between the Central railway line and the Eastern Express Highway at the very edge of Mumbai city, with the Mulund-Airoli Bridge carrying traffic across the creek to Navi Mumbai and the Mulund Check Naka marking the boundary with Thane. The housing here is mixed: older co-operative societies and low-rise buildings in colonies such as Hari Om Nagar and Anand Nagar, some remaining chawls near the highway, and a number of newer mid-rise and high-rise complexes replacing them under redevelopment. Households are mostly Maharashtrian and Gujarati families, many with elderly members, together with working professionals who use the highway to reach Thane, Airoli and Powai. The area is quieter and more affordable than Mulund West across the tracks, and the market lanes near Mulund Railway Station serve daily needs for both sides. Mulund West is immediately across the line, Bhandup lies to the south and Vikhroli is further down the highway. Daily cleaning, cooking help and elder care are the typical requirements, with families generally preferring long-term helpers on fixed timings.
mulund-east.commuteNotes: Mulund Railway Station on the Central line is shared with Mulund West, and BEST buses run along the Eastern Express Highway and the approach to the Mulund-Airoli Bridge. Most helpers live within the older colonies of Mulund East itself and reach households on foot.
mulund-east.housingNotes: Older co-operative buildings and chawls are informal about entry and flexible on timings, while the newer redeveloped complexes along the highway keep helper registers at the gate.

localFaqs.q: Which areas near Mulund East do you also serve?
localFaqs.a: Mulund West, Bhandup and Vikhroli are all covered by the same nearby helper pool as Mulund East. Powai is also within reach for helpers based in this belt.

localFaqs.q: Which pincode does the Mulund East service area cover?
localFaqs.a: Mulund East falls under pincode 400081, which covers colonies such as Hari Om Nagar and Anand Nagar between the railway line and the Eastern Express Highway. Mulund West across the tracks is listed separately under 400080.

localFaqs.q: Do helpers in Mulund East need society gate passes?
localFaqs.a: Older co-operative buildings in Mulund East usually have no formal pass system and rely on the watchman. Newer redeveloped complexes near the Eastern Express Highway may ask for a helper ID entry, so check with your society office.

vashi.localIntro: Vashi is the oldest and most established node of Navi Mumbai, sitting just across the Vashi Bridge from Mankhurd and serving as the commercial centre of the planned city. Its housing is mixed: original CIDCO-built low-rise blocks and row houses in the older sectors, co-operative societies built by private developers through the 1990s, and newer high-rise towers along Palm Beach Road and near the Sector 17 market. Households are largely Maharashtrian and North Indian families who moved here as the city grew, alongside working professionals employed in the offices around Vashi Railway Station and the APMC Market wholesale complex. Inorbit Mall Vashi and Raghuleela Mall are the main shopping and dining destinations, and the Mini Seashore promenade along the creek is the neighbourhood's open space. This locality is listed under pincode 400701 in our records. [VERIFY] Sanpada adjoins Vashi to the south-east, Nerul lies further along the Harbour line and Airoli is up the Thane-Belapur Road to the north. Daily cleaning, cooking help and full-time support for families in the larger societies are the usual requirements.
vashi.commuteNotes: Vashi Railway Station on the Harbour line and NMMT and BEST buses across the Vashi Bridge serve the area, with share autos covering the sectors. Many helpers live in Turbhe and reach Vashi households by bus or share auto.
vashi.housingNotes: Older CIDCO blocks and row houses are informal about entry and flexible on timings, while the newer towers along Palm Beach Road and in the private societies keep helper registers and fixed entry hours at the gate.

localFaqs.q: Which areas near Vashi do you also serve?
localFaqs.a: Sanpada, Nerul and Airoli are covered by the same Navi Mumbai helper pool as Vashi. Helpers based on the Turbhe side regularly take assignments across these nodes.

localFaqs.q: Do helpers in Vashi need society gate passes?
localFaqs.a: The newer towers along Palm Beach Road and most private co-operative societies ask for a helper ID entry at the gate. The older CIDCO blocks and row houses in the early sectors generally have no formal pass system.

localFaqs.q: Is Vashi served from the Mumbai city helper pool or a separate Navi Mumbai one?

localFaqs.a: Yes. Vile Parle and Santacruz stations are both within a short bus or auto ride, and a good share of helpers live in Juhu Koliwada and Nehru Nagar inside the locality itself, so morning and evening slots are generally workable.

vile-parle.localIntro: Vile Parle West, pincode 400056, is one of the western suburbs' most settled residential neighbourhoods, laid out between Vile Parle Railway Station and the Juhu Scheme with S.V. Road running through its middle. The housing is mixed: long-established Gujarati and Maharashtrian cooperative societies, older bungalows in the Parle Tilak and Irla lanes, and a growing number of redeveloped towers. Households here are largely multi-generational families and elderly residents, with a steady student population drawn by Mithibai College and NMIMS on the Juhu side. Nanavati Max Hospital and Cooper Hospital are the area's medical anchors, and Irla Market is the everyday shopping hub. Juhu lies immediately west, Santacruz West is the next station south, and Andheri is one stop north; Vile Parle East and the airport sit across the tracks under a separate pincode. Households commonly look for vegetarian cooks familiar with Gujarati and Maharashtrian kitchens, daily cleaning help, and patient elder-care support for older residents in walk-up buildings.
vile-parle.commuteNotes: Vile Parle station on the Western line and BEST buses along S.V. Road and Juhu Road serve the area, and most helpers walk from the station or come in from the Juhu and Santacruz sides.
vile-parle.housingNotes: Older cooperative societies and bungalows keep timings flexible and entry informal, while the redeveloped towers along S.V. Road and Juhu Road usually register regular domestic staff with the society office.

localFaqs.q: Which areas near Vile Parle do you also serve?
localFaqs.a: Juhu, Santacruz West and Andheri are served by the same nearby helper pool, with Andheri West and Andheri East slightly further out. The Parle Tilak lanes, Irla and the Juhu Scheme side all fall within Vile Parle coverage.

localFaqs.q: Which pincode does the Vile Parle service area cover?
localFaqs.a: This page covers Vile Parle West under pincode 400056, from the station out to the Juhu boundary near Mithibai College. Vile Parle East across the tracks carries a different pincode.

localFaqs.q: Are vegetarian cooks available for households in Vile Parle?
localFaqs.a: Yes. A large share of the households in the Vile Parle cooperative societies keep vegetarian kitchens, so cooks who are used to Gujarati and Maharashtrian preparations are commonly placed here. Preferences can be set at the time of the request.

andheri.localIntro: Andheri under pincode 400058 is the core of Andheri West around the railway station, taking in the S.V. Road belt, the lanes around Gilbert Hill and the Munshi Nagar area near Bhavan's College. It is the busiest interchange in the western suburbs, where the Western line meets Metro Line 1, and that connectivity shapes who lives here: working professionals in older cooperative buildings and redeveloped towers close to the station, families in the quieter lanes around Lallubhai Park, and students near Bhavan's College. The housing is mixed, ranging from decades-old societies and chawls near the station to new high-rises along S.V. Road. Gilbert Hill, the basalt column rising above the neighbourhood, is the area's most distinctive landmark. Andheri West's Lokhandwala and Four Bungalows side lies further west under pincode 400053, Andheri East and the airport belt are across the tracks, and Vile Parle is one station south. Demand is heavy for morning cooking and cleaning help timed around office and college hours, with families asking for full-day support.
andheri.commuteNotes: Andheri station is the main arrival point, served by the Western line and Metro Line 1, with BEST buses fanning out along S.V. Road and Veera Desai Road. Most helpers walk from the station or come in from the Jogeshwari side.
andheri.housingNotes: Older societies and chawls near the station handle entry informally, while the newer towers along S.V. Road and around Lallubhai Park usually require a registered pass for regular domestic staff.

localFaqs.q: Which areas near Andheri do you also serve?
localFaqs.a: Andheri West, Andheri East and Vile Parle are served by the same nearby helper pool, with Juhu, Jogeshwari West and Versova a little further out. The station area, Gilbert Hill and the Bhavan's College lanes all fall within this page's coverage.

localFaqs.q: Which pincode does the Andheri service area cover?
localFaqs.a: This page covers pincode 400058, the Andheri West station belt along S.V. Road. Lokhandwala and Four Bungalows fall under 400053 on the Andheri West page, and Andheri East is under 400059 and 400093.

localFaqs.q: Can helpers reach Andheri before office hours?
localFaqs.a: Yes. Andheri station on the Western line and Metro Line 1 runs services from early morning, and many helpers come from within walking distance of the station, so slots starting between 6 and 8 am are generally workable.

andheri-west.localIntro: Andheri West under pincode 400053 covers Lokhandwala Complex, Four Bungalows, Seven Bungalows and the Oshiwara and Veera Desai Road belt, the part of Andheri that developed as planned apartment townships rather than around the railway station. The dominant housing form is the gated society: large cooperative complexes and high-rise towers with their own security, especially in Lokhandwala and along the Link Road, with a few older bungalow plots surviving in Four Bungalows. Households are mostly working professionals from the media and film production offices nearby, along with families who value the schools, Infiniti Mall and Kokilaben Dhirubhai Ambani Hospital within easy reach. D.N. Nagar Metro Station connects Line 1 and Line 2A, and the Andheri Sports Complex on Veera Desai Road is the main recreation ground. The station-side Andheri belt lies east under pincode 400058, Versova is to the north-west, and Juhu sits to the south. Cooking and cleaning help fitted around long working hours is the main need, with families in the larger societies asking for full-day helpers and nannies.
andheri-west.commuteNotes: D.N. Nagar and Azad Nagar stations on Metro Line 1, the Line 2A stations along Link Road, and BEST buses on Link Road and Veera Desai Road bring helpers in. Many also walk from Behram Baug on the Jogeshwari West side.
andheri-west.housingNotes: Most homes are in gated complexes with security desks, so regular helpers usually need a society-issued pass or ID registration, and timings are set within the society's visitor rules.

localFaqs.q: Which areas near Andheri West do you also serve?
localFaqs.a: The Andheri station belt, Versova and Juhu are served by the same nearby helper pool, with Jogeshwari West and Vile Parle a little further. Lokhandwala, Four Bungalows, Seven Bungalows and Oshiwara all fall within Andheri West coverage.

localFaqs.q: Do helpers in Andheri West need society gate passes?
localFaqs.a: Usually yes. Lokhandwala Complex, Four Bungalows and the Link Road towers are mostly gated societies with security desks, so households generally register a regular helper with the society office and hand over a pass for daily entry.

localFaqs.q: Which pincode does the Andheri West service area cover?
localFaqs.a: This page covers pincode 400053, which takes in Lokhandwala, Four Bungalows, Seven Bungalows and the Veera Desai Road belt. The station-side area around S.V. Road falls under 400058 on the Andheri page.

andheri-east.localIntro: Andheri East, under pincodes 400059 and 400093, is the office and airport side of Andheri, running from the railway station along Andheri-Kurla Road through Chakala and J.B. Nagar to Marol, MIDC and the Mahakali Caves Road belt. The housing is mixed: older cooperative societies in J.B. Nagar and Vijay Nagar, chawls and urban villages such as Marol Gaon, and new high-rise towers built around the office parks and the Western Express Highway. Households are predominantly working professionals employed in the MIDC, Chakala and airport-zone companies, along with families in the established societies near Holy Spirit Hospital and the Mahakali Caves. Metro Line 1 runs down the middle of the area with stations at Western Express Highway, Chakala, Airport Road and Marol Naka, and Line 3 now adds Marol Naka and MIDC-Andheri stops underground. The Andheri station belt lies across the tracks to the west, Jogeshwari East is north beyond the highway, and Powai sits to the east past Marol. Demand is strongest for morning and evening cooking and cleaning help fitted around shift-based and office timings.
andheri-east.commuteNotes: Metro Line 1 (Western Express Highway, Chakala, Airport Road and Marol Naka stations), Line 7 at Gundavali and Andheri station's east exit all serve the area, along with BEST buses on Andheri-Kurla Road. Helpers also walk in from the Marol and Sahar village settlements.
andheri-east.housingNotes: Older societies and chawls in J.B. Nagar and Marol keep entry simple, while the newer towers near the highway and MIDC follow gated-society rules with registered passes for regular staff.

localFaqs.q: Which areas near Andheri East do you also serve?
localFaqs.a: The Andheri station belt, Vile Parle and Jogeshwari East are served by the same nearby helper pool, with Powai and Kurla further out. Chakala, J.B. Nagar, Marol, MIDC and the Mahakali Caves Road belt all fall within Andheri East coverage.

localFaqs.q: Which pincodes does the Andheri East service area cover?
localFaqs.a: Andheri East is served under two pincodes: 400059, which covers the station side, Chakala, J.B. Nagar and Marol, and 400093, which covers the MIDC and Mahakali Caves Road belt. Both are handled as one locality here.

localFaqs.q: Can helpers in Andheri East work around shift timings?
localFaqs.a: Generally yes. With Metro Line 1 stations at Chakala, Airport Road and Marol Naka and buses on Andheri-Kurla Road, helpers can reach most societies early or late, and households with airport or IT shift timings can set fixed morning or evening slots at the time of booking.

versova.localIntro: Versova, pincode 400061, is the coastal end of Andheri West, where Yari Road and the Seven Bungalows side run out to Versova Beach and the jetty that ferries people across to Madh Island. The housing is mixed: apartment blocks along Yari Road and Aram Nagar, a scattering of bungalows and low-rise buildings near the shore, and the old fishing village of Versova Koliwada, which remains a working Koli settlement. Households are largely working professionals from film, television and advertising who have settled near the Lokhandwala and Yari Road studios, along with families drawn to the sea breeze and the relatively quiet lanes. Versova Metro Station is the western terminus of Metro Line 1 and the area's main transit link, and the beach front and jetty give the locality its distinctive character. Andheri West's Lokhandwala and Four Bungalows lie immediately east, Juhu is to the south along the coast, and Jogeshwari West sits across the creek to the north-east. The usual needs are cooks and daily cleaning help for professionals with irregular hours, plus full-day support for families.
versova.commuteNotes: Versova Metro Station on Line 1 and BEST buses along Yari Road and J.P. Road bring helpers in from the Andheri side, and many walk from the settlements within Versova Koliwada and the Yari Road lanes.
versova.housingNotes: Apartment societies on Yari Road and Aram Nagar generally keep a register of regular helpers at the gate, while the bungalows and older buildings near the beach handle entry directly with the household.

localFaqs.q: Which areas near Versova do you also serve?
localFaqs.a: Andheri West's Lokhandwala and Seven Bungalows side, the Andheri station belt and Juhu are served by the same nearby helper pool, with Jogeshwari West a little further. Yari Road, Aram Nagar and Versova Koliwada all fall within Versova coverage.

localFaqs.q: Which pincode does the Versova service area cover?
localFaqs.a: Versova falls under pincode 400061, which covers Yari Road, Aram Nagar, Versova Koliwada and the beachfront. The adjoining Lokhandwala and Four Bungalows area is pincode 400053 on the Andheri West page.

localFaqs.q: How do helpers reach Versova?
localFaqs.a: Versova Metro Station, the terminus of Metro Line 1, is the main arrival point, and BEST buses run along Yari Road and J.P. Road. Helpers who live within Versova Koliwada and the Yari Road lanes usually walk.

jogeshwari-east.localIntro: Jogeshwari East, pincode 400096, lies between the Western Express Highway and the edge of Aarey Colony, and is anchored by the SEEPZ export zone and the Jogeshwari-Vikhroli Link Road that carries traffic across to Powai. The housing is mixed: long-standing chawls and settlements in Meghwadi, Majas and Pratap Nagar, MHADA and cooperative buildings, and a newer line of high-rise towers along the JVLR and the highway. Households are a blend of working-class and middle-class families who have lived here for generations and professionals who have moved into the towers for the short commute to SEEPZ and the Andheri East offices. The Jogeshwari Caves, a rock-cut temple complex in Pratap Nagar, are the area's oldest landmark. Metro Line 7 stops at Jogeshwari East on the highway and Line 3 runs underground with stations at Aarey JVLR and SEEPZ. Jogeshwari West is across the railway line, Andheri East lies south along the highway, and Goregaon East is the next stretch north. Daily cleaning and cooking help for family homes is the main demand, with tower residents asking for fixed-time morning slots.
jogeshwari-east.commuteNotes: Jogeshwari station's east side, Jogeshwari East station on Metro Line 7 and the Aarey JVLR and SEEPZ stations on Line 3 serve the area, with BEST buses along the JVLR. Most helpers walk in from the settlements in Meghwadi and Majas.
jogeshwari-east.housingNotes: Chawls and older MHADA buildings manage entry informally with flexible timings, while the newer towers along the JVLR and the highway follow gated-society rules with registered passes for regular staff.

localFaqs.q: Which areas near Jogeshwari East do you also serve?
localFaqs.a: Jogeshwari West, Andheri East and Goregaon East are served by the same nearby helper pool, with Powai across the JVLR a little further. Meghwadi, Majas, Pratap Nagar and the SEEPZ side all fall within Jogeshwari East coverage.

localFaqs.q: Which pincode does the Jogeshwari East service area cover?
localFaqs.a: Jogeshwari East falls under pincode 400096, which includes SEEPZ, the JVLR belt and the residential pockets up to the Aarey boundary. Jogeshwari West across the tracks is pincode 400102.

localFaqs.q: Do helpers in Jogeshwari East need society gate passes?
localFaqs.a: In the newer towers along the JVLR and the Western Express Highway, yes; those societies generally register regular helpers at the gate. The older chawls and MHADA buildings in Meghwadi and Majas usually manage entry directly with the household.

jogeshwari-west.localIntro: Jogeshwari West, pincode 400102, runs from Jogeshwari Railway Station across S.V. Road to the Oshiwara side of the Link Road, where the locality merges into the northern edge of Andheri West. The housing is mixed: dense chawls and settlements such as Behram Baug and the lanes around the station, older cooperative buildings along S.V. Road, and a belt of newer high-rise towers on the Oshiwara and Link Road side close to Mega Mall. Households range from long-settled working-class and middle-class families near the station to professionals who have taken flats in the Oshiwara towers for their proximity to the Lokhandwala offices and studios. Metro Line 2A's Oshiwara and Lower Oshiwara stations sit along the Link Road, and the Oshiwara police station and Mega Mall are the everyday reference points. Jogeshwari East lies across the tracks, Andheri West's Lokhandwala is directly south, and Goregaon West is the next stretch north. Demand centres on daily cleaning and cooking help for family homes, with the Oshiwara towers asking for fixed-slot morning helpers.
jogeshwari-west.commuteNotes: Jogeshwari station on the Western line, the Oshiwara and Lower Oshiwara stations on Metro Line 2A and BEST buses on S.V. Road and Link Road serve the area. A large share of helpers walk in from Behram Baug and the lanes near the station.
jogeshwari-west.housingNotes: Chawls and older buildings near the station and S.V. Road manage entry informally, while the Oshiwara and Link Road towers follow gated-society rules and register regular domestic staff.

localFaqs.q: Which areas near Jogeshwari West do you also serve?
localFaqs.a: Jogeshwari East, Andheri West and Goregaon West are served by the same nearby helper pool. Oshiwara, Behram Baug, the S.V. Road belt and the Link Road towers all fall within Jogeshwari West coverage.

localFaqs.q: Which pincode does the Jogeshwari West service area cover?
localFaqs.a: Jogeshwari West falls under pincode 400102, which covers the station side, S.V. Road and the Oshiwara stretch of the Link Road. Jogeshwari East across the railway line is pincode 400096.

localFaqs.q: Can helpers reach the Oshiwara towers in Jogeshwari West early?
localFaqs.a: Yes. Many helpers live within walking distance in Behram Baug and the lanes near Jogeshwari station, and Metro Line 2A's Oshiwara station is on the Link Road, so early-morning slots at the Oshiwara societies are generally workable.

goregaon-east.localIntro: Goregaon East, under pincodes 400063 and 400065, stretches from Goregaon Railway Station across the Western Express Highway to Film City and the green expanse of Aarey Milk Colony. The housing is mixed: older cooperative societies and MHADA colonies in Dindoshi and Nagari Niwara, chawls and settlements near the station, and large gated townships built along the highway around Oberoi Mall and NESCO, which have brought in a sizeable professional population. Households are therefore a blend of long-settled families in the older colonies and younger working couples in the new towers, many employed at the NESCO IT park and the offices along the highway. Metro Line 7 stops at Goregaon East and Aarey on the highway, and Film City continues to draw production staff into the area every day. Goregaon West is across the railway line, Jogeshwari East is the next stretch south along the highway, and Malad East lies to the north past Dindoshi. Daily cleaning and cooking help for families is the core demand, with the township societies asking for fixed-slot helpers registered with their security.
goregaon-east.commuteNotes: Goregaon station's east exit, the Goregaon East and Aarey stations on Metro Line 7 and BEST buses along the highway and the Aarey Road serve the area. Helpers also walk in from the settlements near the station and along Film City Road.
goregaon-east.housingNotes: The gated townships along the highway keep security desks and issue passes for regular domestic staff, while the older colonies in Dindoshi and Nagari Niwara and the chawls near the station manage entry directly with households.

localFaqs.q: Which areas near Goregaon East do you also serve?
localFaqs.a: Goregaon West, Jogeshwari East and Malad East are served by the same nearby helper pool, with Powai across Aarey a little further. Dindoshi, Nagari Niwara, the Film City Road belt and the townships near Oberoi Mall all fall within Goregaon East coverage.

localFaqs.q: Which pincodes does the Goregaon East service area cover?
localFaqs.a: Goregaon East is handled under two pincodes: 400063, which covers the station side and the highway belt around NESCO and Oberoi Mall, and 400065, which covers Film City Road, Aarey and the Dindoshi side. Both are treated as one locality here.

localFaqs.q: Do helpers in Goregaon East need society gate passes?
localFaqs.a: In the gated townships along the Western Express Highway, yes; those societies generally require regular helpers to be registered with security and carry a pass. The older MHADA colonies in Dindoshi and Nagari Niwara usually handle entry informally.

goregaon-west.localIntro: Goregaon West, pincode 400104, is the residential side of Goregaon between the railway line and the Link Road, taking in Bangur Nagar, Motilal Nagar, Siddharth Nagar and the lanes along S.V. Road. The housing is mixed: MHADA and cooperative colonies from the 1970s and 1980s in Motilal Nagar and Siddharth Nagar, a few surviving chawls near the station, and a growing band of redeveloped towers along the Link Road on the Bangur Nagar side. Households are mainly middle-class families who have been in the colonies for decades, with professionals moving into the newer buildings for the metro and the office belt in Goregaon East and Malad. Goregaon and Ram Mandir stations serve the Western line, and Metro Line 2A's Goregaon West and Bangur Nagar stations run along the Link Road. Goregaon East lies across the tracks, Malad West is the next stretch north along the Link Road, and Jogeshwari West is south beyond Ram Mandir. Daily cleaning and cooking help for family homes is the main need, with elder-care support common in the older colony buildings.
goregaon-west.commuteNotes: Goregaon and Ram Mandir stations on the Western line, the Goregaon West and Bangur Nagar stations on Metro Line 2A and BEST buses on S.V. Road and Link Road bring helpers in, and many walk from the settlements near the station.
goregaon-west.housingNotes: The MHADA and cooperative colonies in Motilal Nagar and Siddharth Nagar handle entry informally with flexible hours, while the redeveloped Link Road towers around Bangur Nagar register regular domestic staff at the gate.

localFaqs.q: Which areas near Goregaon West do you also serve?
localFaqs.a: Goregaon East, Malad West and Jogeshwari West are served by the same nearby helper pool. Bangur Nagar, Motilal Nagar, Siddharth Nagar and the S.V. Road belt all fall within Goregaon West coverage.

localFaqs.q: Which pincode does the Goregaon West service area cover?
localFaqs.a: Goregaon West falls under pincode 400104, which covers the area between Goregaon station and the Link Road including Bangur Nagar and Motilal Nagar. Goregaon East across the railway line is under 400063 and 400065.

localFaqs.q: How do helpers usually reach Goregaon West?
localFaqs.a: Most arrive via Goregaon or Ram Mandir stations on the Western line, or via the Goregaon West and Bangur Nagar stops on Metro Line 2A along the Link Road. Helpers living near the station usually walk to the Motilal Nagar and S.V. Road buildings.

malad-west.localIntro: Malad West, pincode 400064, spreads from Malad Railway Station across S.V. Road and the Link Road towards Marve Road, Orlem and the Mindspace office belt near Chincholi Bunder. The housing is mixed: older cooperative buildings and the East Indian village lanes of Orlem, MHADA and chawl pockets near the station, and a large number of newer high-rise societies along the Link Road and Marve Road that have grown up around Inorbit Mall, Infiniti Mall and the Mindspace IT park. Households are a blend of long-settled families, many of them in the older Orlem and Liberty Garden lanes, and working professionals who took flats close to the Mindspace offices. Metro Line 2A's Malad West and Lower Malad stations sit on the Link Road. Goregaon West is the next stretch south, Kandivali West lies north past Charkop, and Malad East is across the tracks. Daily cleaning and cooking help for family homes is the main demand, with the Link Road societies asking for fixed morning slots for working couples.
malad-west.commuteNotes: Malad station on the Western line, the Malad West and Lower Malad stations on Metro Line 2A and BEST buses along S.V. Road, Link Road and Marve Road serve the area. A significant share of helpers come in from Malwani on the Marve Road side.
malad-west.housingNotes: Newer societies along the Link Road and Marve Road are gated with security desks and register regular helpers, while the older buildings in Orlem and near Liberty Garden handle entry directly with households.

localFaqs.q: Which areas near Malad West do you also serve?
localFaqs.a: Malad East, Goregaon West and Kandivali West are served by the same nearby helper pool. Orlem, Liberty Garden, the Link Road belt near Inorbit Mall and the Mindspace side all fall within Malad West coverage.

localFaqs.q: Which pincode does the Malad West service area cover?
localFaqs.a: Malad West falls under pincode 400064, which covers the station side, S.V. Road, the Link Road belt and Orlem. Malad East across the railway line is pincode 400097.

localFaqs.q: Do helpers in Malad West need society gate passes?
localFaqs.a: Most of the newer societies along the Link Road and Marve Road are gated and ask households to register a regular helper with security. The older buildings in Orlem and near Liberty Garden usually manage entry informally.

malad-east.localIntro: Malad East, pincode 400097, runs from the east side of Malad Railway Station across the Western Express Highway to Kurar Village, Pathanwadi and the hillside settlements that back onto Sanjay Gandhi National Park. The housing is mixed in the fullest sense: dense settlements and chawls in Kurar Village and Appapada, older cooperative buildings between the station and the highway, and a fast-growing line of high-rise societies along the highway and Dindoshi that draw working professionals. Households range from long-settled working-class and middle-class families to younger couples in the new towers who commute to the Goregaon and Malad office parks. Metro Line 7 stops at Kurar and Dindoshi on the highway, which has made the eastern side much easier to reach. Malad West is across the tracks, Goregaon East lies south past Dindoshi, and Kandivali East is the next stretch north along the highway. Daily cleaning and cooking help for family homes is the main need, and because so many helpers live within the locality itself, morning slots are generally easy to fill.
malad-east.commuteNotes: Malad station's east side, the Kurar and Dindoshi stations on Metro Line 7 and BEST buses along the highway serve the area, and a large share of helpers walk in from Kurar Village and Appapada.
malad-east.housingNotes: The high-rise societies along the highway and in Dindoshi are gated and register regular helpers at the security desk, while the chawls and older buildings in Kurar and near the station manage entry directly with households.

localFaqs.q: Which areas near Malad East do you also serve?
localFaqs.a: Malad West, Goregaon East and Kandivali East are served by the same nearby helper pool. Kurar Village, Pathanwadi, Dindoshi and the highway belt all fall within Malad East coverage.

localFaqs.q: Which pincode does the Malad East service area cover?
localFaqs.a: Malad East falls under pincode 400097, which covers the area east of Malad station including Kurar Village, Pathanwadi and the Western Express Highway belt. Malad West across the line is pincode 400064.

localFaqs.q: Are helpers available for early-morning slots in Malad East?
localFaqs.a: Yes. Many helpers live within walking distance in Kurar Village and Appapada, and Metro Line 7's Kurar and Dindoshi stations serve the highway-side societies, so 6 to 8 am starts are generally workable.

kandivali-east.localIntro: Kandivali East, pincode 400101, lies between the Western Express Highway and the forest edge of Sanjay Gandhi National Park, and is best known for Thakur Village, Thakur Complex and Lokhandwala Township, the planned residential townships that give the area its character. The dominant housing form is the gated society: large cooperative complexes and high-rise towers with their own security and internal roads, with older MHADA and chawl pockets in Samta Nagar, Hanuman Nagar and along Akurli Road. Households are mostly families, many of them with school-age children, along with working professionals who commute down the highway to the Goregaon and Andheri office belts. Growel's 101 Mall on Akurli Road is the everyday shopping hub, and Metro Line 7's Akurli and Poisar stations on the highway now put the townships within a short walk of rapid transit. Kandivali West is across the railway line, Malad East is the next stretch south along the highway, and Dahisar lies north past Borivali. Full-day and fixed-slot helpers, cooks and childcare support for family homes are the common requirements.
kandivali-east.commuteNotes: The Akurli and Poisar stations on Metro Line 7, Kandivali station's east exit and BEST buses along Akurli Road and the highway serve the area. Many helpers walk in from Damu Nagar and the settlements along the park boundary.
kandivali-east.housingNotes: Thakur Village, Thakur Complex and Lokhandwala Township are gated townships with security at every entrance, so regular helpers generally need a society-issued pass or ID registration and follow the complex's visitor timings.

localFaqs.q: Which areas near Kandivali East do you also serve?
localFaqs.a: Kandivali West, Malad East and Dahisar are served by the same nearby helper pool. Thakur Village, Thakur Complex, Lokhandwala Township, Samta Nagar and the Akurli Road belt all fall within Kandivali East coverage.

localFaqs.q: Do helpers in Kandivali East need society gate passes?
localFaqs.a: Usually yes. The townships in Thakur Village and Lokhandwala Township are gated with security desks, so households generally register a regular helper with the society office and hand over a pass for daily entry.

localFaqs.q: Which pincode does the Kandivali East service area cover?
localFaqs.a: Kandivali East falls under pincode 400101, which takes in Thakur Village, Lokhandwala Township, Samta Nagar and Akurli Road. Kandivali West across the railway line is pincode 400067.

kandivali-west.localIntro: Kandivali West, pincode 400067, extends from Kandivali Railway Station across S.V. Road and the Link Road into Mahavir Nagar and the planned sectors of Charkop, with the Charkop industrial estate and the metro depot at its western edge. The housing is mixed: cooperative societies from the 1980s and 1990s in Mahavir Nagar and Charkop, older buildings and chawls near the station, and a newer generation of redeveloped towers along the Link Road. Households are predominantly Gujarati and Maharashtrian families who have lived here for years, with a noticeable number of elderly residents in the older societies and younger couples in the redeveloped buildings. Raghuleela Mega Mall near the station and the municipal Shatabdi Hospital are everyday reference points, and Metro Line 2A's Kandivali West and Dahanukarwadi stations run along the Link Road. Kandivali East lies across the tracks, Malad West is the next stretch south, and Dahisar sits north beyond Borivali. Vegetarian cooks, daily cleaning help and elder-care support for the older societies are the common needs here.
kandivali-west.commuteNotes: Kandivali station on the Western line, the Kandivali West and Dahanukarwadi stations on Metro Line 2A and BEST buses on S.V. Road and Link Road serve the area, and most helpers walk from the station or the Charkop side.
kandivali-west.housingNotes: The cooperative societies in Mahavir Nagar and Charkop generally keep a simple register of regular helpers and allow flexible timings, while the redeveloped Link Road towers follow gated-society rules with passes for domestic staff.

localFaqs.q: Which areas near Kandivali West do you also serve?
localFaqs.a: Kandivali East, Malad West and Dahisar are served by the same nearby helper pool. Mahavir Nagar, Charkop, the S.V. Road belt and the Link Road towers all fall within Kandivali West coverage.

localFaqs.q: Which pincode does the Kandivali West service area cover?
localFaqs.a: Kandivali West falls under pincode 400067, which covers the area west of Kandivali station including Mahavir Nagar and Charkop. Kandivali East across the railway line is pincode 400101.

localFaqs.q: Are vegetarian cooks available for households in Kandivali West?
localFaqs.a: Yes. A large share of the families in the Mahavir Nagar and Charkop societies keep vegetarian kitchens, so cooks experienced with Gujarati and Maharashtrian preparations are commonly placed here. Dietary preferences can be set when making the request.

dahisar.localIntro: Dahisar, pincode 400068, is the northernmost locality within Mumbai's municipal limits, sitting on both sides of the Western line between Borivali and the Dahisar Check Naka that marks the boundary with Mira Road. The pincode covers both Dahisar East and Dahisar West. The housing is mixed: older cooperative societies and chawls near the station and along S.V. Road, MHADA-style colonies in Anand Nagar and Ketkipada, and a fast-growing belt of new high-rise societies on the Link Road extension in the west and along the Western Express Highway in the east, where the land backs onto Sanjay Gandhi National Park. Households are mainly middle-class families, with a growing number of working professionals who chose Dahisar for its two metro lines: Line 2A along the Link Road and Line 7 along the highway meet at the Dahisar East interchange, with Anand Nagar and Kandarpada as the other local stops. Kandivali West and Kandivali East are the nearest covered localities south beyond Borivali, and Malad lies further down the line. Daily cleaning, cooking help and childcare support for family homes are the usual requirements.
dahisar.commuteNotes: Dahisar station on the Western line, the Dahisar East interchange between Metro Lines 2A and 7, and the Anand Nagar and Kandarpada stations on Line 2A serve the area, with BEST buses along S.V. Road and the highway. Some helpers also travel in from the Mira Road side across the check naka.
dahisar.housingNotes: The new societies along the Link Road extension and the highway are gated and register regular helpers at the security desk, while the older buildings and chawls near the station and in Anand Nagar manage entry directly with households.

localFaqs.q: Which areas near Dahisar do you also serve?
localFaqs.a: Kandivali West and Kandivali East are the nearest covered localities, with Malad West and Malad East further south. Dahisar East, Dahisar West, Anand Nagar, Ketkipada and the Link Road extension all fall within Dahisar coverage.

localFaqs.q: Which pincode does the Dahisar service area cover?
localFaqs.a: Dahisar falls under a single pincode, 400068, which covers both Dahisar East and Dahisar West up to the Dahisar Check Naka. Mira Road beyond the check naka is outside the Mumbai municipal area and is not part of this locality page.

localFaqs.q: How do helpers reach Dahisar?
localFaqs.a: Dahisar station on the Western line and the Dahisar East metro interchange between Lines 2A and 7 are the main arrival points, with Anand Nagar and Kandarpada stations on Line 2A serving the west side. Helpers living near the station and in Anand Nagar usually walk.
